sn35.68:1.1: la || Loko lokoti bhante vuccati || Kittāvatā nu kho bhante loko vā assa lokapaññatti vā ti || || Yattha kho Samiddhi atthi cakkhum atthi rūpā atthi cakkhuviññāṇam atthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || atthi tattha loko vā lokapaññatti vā || || la || || Atthi mano atthi dhammā atthi manoviññāṇaṃ atthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || atthi tattha loko vā lokapaññatti vā || ||
sn35.68:2.1: Yattha ca kho Samiddhi natthi cakkhu natthi rūpā natthi cakkhuviññāṇam natthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || natthi tattha loko vā lokapaññatti vā || || la || || natthi jivhā natthi rasā || pe || natthi mano natthi dhammā natthi manoviññāṇaṃ natthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || natthi tattha loko vā lokapaññatti vā ti || ||
